purpose: Diagnostic stage of the active six-feature DREChannNet optimization goal; not a substitute for a >0.64 Macro-F1 improved final model and not a new model-performance claim.
roles: Exactly the completed temporal-PR study's five label-free within-original-FIT TRAIN/CAL/ASSESS assignments, identical across all three seeds. TRAIN34-36, CAL8, ASSESS8 per fold; 40 assessment appearances/33 unique patients. Original Development and ownOuter excluded. Repeated research use of this internal assessment is disclosed, not independent confirmation.
architecture: Original six-feature no-Variance/no-head-interaction single-head network, 11425 parameters in every arm. Early FiLM, late Gate, pre-ictal raw latent reference, full differentiable pooling, 96 raw summary coordinates, 14-wide physiology with the two Variance coordinates permanently masked, 64-hidden head, waveform normalization and all initializers unchanged. No temporal-contrast addition, new feature, source classifier, ranking loss or extra module.
feature_pr: FULL/WO_RAW_PR: exact original patient_z on the 14-wide summary followed by TRAIN-only SimpleImputer and StandardScaler. WO_FEATURE_PR/WO_BOTH_PR: omit only patient_z; fit a new SimpleImputer and StandardScaler on the same TRAIN raw summary rows. No patient-specific labels or statistics from other patients in CAL/ASSESS. Mask Variance before the model reads the input. Window-level DELTA conditioning is unchanged, because it is not this summary Feature PR operation.
raw_pr: FULL/WO_FEATURE_PR: exact differentiable coordinate-wise final 96D patient Z. WO_RAW_PR/WO_BOTH_PR: bypass only that operation, retaining the original unstandardized pooled raw vector, complete aggregation and trainable head. Same original matched-ablation definition; no added scale matching, hidden capacity, threshold sabotage or inference-only deletion. Scale differences will be audited and can motivate a separately frozen next experiment, not be mistaken for proof of physiological necessity.
training: All four arms use the same original initializer/RNG consumption. Reuse only15 completed internal B0 cells after byte/hash/initializer/preprocessing/roles/selected-CAL-logit replay, because they have exactly these TRAIN/CAL/ASSESS roles and seeds. Train45 new cells from scratch. AdamW lr0.0003, wd0.001, clip1, FP32 TF32off, full-patient updates, 4096-window chunks, original weighted BCE/softMacroF1, max30/min6/patience6. CAL alone selects epochs and original201-grid thresholds. Atomic LAST includes optimizer/RNG/history; no blind native retries or outcome tuning.
freeze: Verify all60 selected checkpoints, preprocessors, CAL predictions/epochs/thresholds before any new ASSESS prediction. Preserve old15 B0 predictions and hash-reuse only exact same assessment indices. Seal all60 cells before unified metrics. No new final-stage fit, Outer read or Outer inference is implemented by this diagnostic protocol.
estimand: All nine original endpoints. Average repeated folds within each unique patient and seed; average metrics, not probabilities, across seeds; then equal-weight33patients. Report pooled appearances separately, seed/fold/source summaries, coverage, sampleSD. 10000seed42 paired unique-patient bootstrap, all paths/seeds kept paired. Conditional intervals exclude historical architecture selection and full training randomness.
contrasts: Four absolute results plus eight paired factorial contrasts: FeaturePR with/without RawPR, RawPR with/without FeaturePR, bothPR joint, difference-of-differences interaction, two average factorial main effects. Nine endpoints each=108 nominal intervals. Four extra Bonferroni percentile intervals for FULL-minus-each-single-PR-ablation x AUROC/MacroF1. No significance fishing or changing interval family after results.
evidence_rule: For each single-PR removal separately, call stable positive point evidence only if FULL has strictly higher mean AUROC and MacroF1 AND both deltas are positive in at least2/3seeds. Report nominal/family intervals separately; no claim of statistical support if the corresponding interval includes0. A failed PR contribution cannot be hidden or made positive by weakening controls. This diagnostic is not a final-model eligibility gate; even a pass is not achievement of the >0.64 final Outer objective.
execution: Use the already admitted isolated D-drive Python/Torch runtime and logical CPU16-31 affinity for owned workers only; no unsafe KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK, BIOS/driver/security-service changes. Freeze new sources and push GitHub before formal training. No Raw copying or re-extraction.
scientific_status: EXPLORATORY_REPEATED_TEST; current and historical internal/Outer cohort exposure prevents independent-confirmation claims.
privacy: Only source, hashes and anonymous aggregate audits/results go to GitHub. Waveforms/identities/individual predictions/weights/preprocessors/cache/runtime logs remain on trusted server. No automatic new Outer based on this result. Original completed studies remain byte unchanged.
